bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
f="$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
client="$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
helper="$root/scripts/userbot_link_flow_smoke.py"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test -f "$f" && test -f "$client" && test ! -e "$helper" || exit 62
grep -Fq '"link_button_smoke"' "$f" || exit 63
grep -Fq 'if action == "link_button_smoke":' "$f" || exit 64
grep -Fq 'timeout=95 if request.get("action")' "$f" || exit 65
git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = bfe9f019711759cba48749de1125deeb73408b72 || exit 66
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/link62-registrationsmoke.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git -C "$root" show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_link_flow_smoke.py >"$tmp/helper.py"
python3 -B -c 'import ast,sys;ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf8").read())' "$tmp/helper.py"
cp -p "$f" "$tmp/old-ipc.py"
cp -p "$client" "$tmp/old-client.py"
python3 -B - "$f" "$client" "$tmp" <<'PY'
import ast,sys,pathlib
f,c,t=map(pathlib.Path,sys.argv[1:])
s=f.read_text(encoding="utf8")
def one(text,a,b):
 if text.count(a)!=1:raise SystemExit(67)
 return text.replace(a,b,1)
s=one(s,'"link_button_smoke",','"link_button_smoke", "link_registration_smoke",')
anchor='    if action == "room_private_smoke":'
block='''    if action == "link_registration_smoke":
        from userbot_link_flow_smoke import run
        result=await run(client)
        if not all(result.get(k) is True for k in (
                "link_editor_opened", "two_line_button_accepted",
                "blue_selected", "preview_present", "registration_receipt")):
            raise RuntimeError("LINK_REGISTRATION_SMOKE_INCOMPLETE")
        return {"request_id": request_id, **result}
'''
s=one(s,anchor,block+anchor)
s=one(s,'{"room_public_post_smoke", "bug_report_delivery_smoke"}',
      '{"room_public_post_smoke", "bug_report_delivery_smoke", "link_registration_smoke"}')
ast.parse(s)
(t/"new-ipc.py").write_text(s,encoding="utf8")
v=c.read_text(encoding="utf8")
v=one(v,'{"room_public_post_smoke", "bug_report_delivery_smoke"}',
      '{"room_public_post_smoke", "bug_report_delivery_smoke", "link_registration_smoke"}')
ast.parse(v)
(t/"new-client.py").write_text(v,encoding="utf8")
PY
restore(){
 cp -p "$tmp/old-ipc.py" "$f"
 cp -p "$tmp/old-client.py" "$client"
 rm -f "$helper"
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
cp "$tmp/new-ipc.py" "$f"
cp "$tmp/new-client.py" "$client"
cp "$tmp/helper.py" "$helper"
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 68
(cd "$root/scripts" && python3 -B userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null) || exit 69
(cd "$root/scripts" && python3 -B userbot_test_client.py link_registration_smoke >/dev/null) || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
trap - ERR
echo LINK_REGISTER_DM_E2E=PASS
echo USERBOT_AUTH_SESSION_KEPT=PASS
echo NO_GROUP_MESSAGES_SENT=PASS
